papers.rationale: Central ObjectNav verification contribution improves success and path efficiency in comparative Gibson and Habitat-Matterport 3D evaluations.
Safe intersection traversal directly addresses vehicle navigation; stability proofs and CARLA demonstrations are stated, but comparative evaluation is unspecified.
Interruption-aware UAS navigation is central; comparative simulations quantify collision and mission-failure reductions against recurrent baselines.
Dexterous hands appear within a video-judging benchmark, without manipulation control contributions; comparative evaluation demonstrates transfer to external benchmarks.
Visual counting audits do not address the topic filters; nine-model comparisons across images and harness conditions provide dataset evaluation.
Controlled evaluation of closed-loop driving navigation compares memory designs and audited baselines in HighwayEnv with resampled pools and token-matched controls.
Hierarchical scene maps directly support language-guided navigation; comparative dataset evaluations establish scene-graph and segmentation gains, without navigation trials.
Sensor calibration addresses none of the specified topics directly; real-world evaluations explicitly validate zero-shot transfer across camera-LiDAR configurations.
Topo-metric visual localization contributes directly to navigation capability; public and custom dataset experiments report comparative accuracy and reliability.
Broad physical-AI review covers motor control and robotics incidentally relative to specific filters; no original empirical evaluation is described.
Latent planning costs centrally improve navigation planning; comparative evaluation across six environments reports substantial navigation success gains.
Generic preference alignment for embodied control specifies none of the topic filters; experiments explicitly demonstrate generalization to out-of-distribution users.
Cylindrical-object pose measurement does not directly address the filters; Monte Carlo comparisons validate analytical bounds across marker geometries.
